messages:
Elaine: Kicking off a canonical internal incident-comms thread so we have copy/paste-ready snippets for pages, internal announcements, status page updates, and customer emails. Want: consistent tone, explicit placeholders, and a tiny live-mitigation checklist.

incident-bot: Heads-up: draft PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-docs/pull/482 (branch: incident-comms-library). Reviews appreciated.

Raj: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) enumerate all placeholders in snake_case; 2) include a 1-line pager snippet for SREs getting a page.

Kim: Tone guidance: plain, non-accusatory, active voice. Use "impact" instead of "outage" unless total loss. Avoid speculative ETAs.

Derek: Customers primarily want to know: are they affected? then what are we doing. Keep those sections separate.

Elaine: Draft templates below. Please comment in the PR. I'll collect feedback and push v1.1 later today.

---

(1) Pager / 1-line escalation (for pages or SMS)

Elaine: ```{recipient}: Paged for incident {incident_id}. Service: {service}. Impact: {impact_summary}. Current status: {current_status}. On-call: @{oncall}. Channel: #{channel}.```

Use this for first-page context. Keep it <2 lines for quick triage.

(2) Internal announcement (Slack post, 2-4 lines)

Elaine: ```[INCIDENT] {service} experiencing degraded performance since {impact_start} UTC 12 {impact_summary}. On-call: @{oncall}. Triage: #{channel}. Status: {status_page_link}.```

Notes: include incident tag, link triage channel and status page, no hypothesis about cause unless validated.

(3) Public status page short update

Elaine: ```Summary: Users may see {user_visible_symptom} in {service}. Incident ID: {incident_id}.
What we're doing: {mitigation_steps_brief}.
Next update: {eta_or_time_window} or "We will provide updates as available."```

(4) Customer initial notification (email/snippet)

Elaine: ```Subject: Incident {incident_id}: {service} partial degradation

Hello,

We are aware of an issue impacting {service} that may cause {user_visible_symptom}. Our operations team is actively investigating and working on mitigation. We will post updates at {status_page_link} and follow up with details once available.

Customers impacted: {customers_impacted_or_percent}
Detected: {impact_start}
Support contact: {support_contact}

Thank you for your patience.

 Redwood Inference Operations```

Tone: concise, empathetic, non-technical, point to status page & support.

(5) Customer resolution / follow-up

Elaine: ```Subject: Incident {incident_id} resolved: {service}

Hello,

The issue affecting {service} since {impact_start} UTC was resolved at {resolved_time} UTC. High-level cause: {short_root_cause}. Actions taken: {remediation_summary}. If you continue to see problems, contact {support_contact}.

We apologize for the disruption.

 Redwood Inference Operations```

(6) On-call handoff (end of shift)

Elaine: ```Handoff: Incident {incident_id}
- Status: {current_status}
- Next owner: @{next_oncall} (ownership moves at {handoff_time} UTC)
- Next actions: {next_steps}
- Watch window: {watch_window}
- Links: {runbook_link}, {status_page_link}, #{channel}```

Outgoing on-call checklist: ensure alerts are tuned, list any temporary mitigations, leave explicit next steps.

---

Raj: Placeholder list suggestion (snake_case): {incident_id}, {service}, {impact_start}, {impact_end}, {oncall}, {channel}, {status_page_link}, {support_contact}, {customers_impacted_or_percent}, {user_visible_symptom}, {current_status}, {mitigation_steps_brief}, {current_mitigation}, {short_root_cause}, {resolved_time}, {next_steps}, {handoff_time}, {runbook_link}, {customer_messaging_owner}, {account_team_contact}.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link template: https://kb.redwood/internals/runbooks/{service}/incident-runbook

Kim: Slight copy edit: use "we are aware and actively investigating" in customer-facing text for tone. Also add a "what not to say" bullet: no team blame, no speculation, no unverified ETA.

Derek: Add separate line in internal posts: "Customer impact: {customer_impact_summary}" before technical root cause.

product-ops: Request: add a {customer_messaging_owner} placeholder so engineering knows who signs customer comms. Also a canned escalation line for paid customers: "Account teams have been notified: {account_team_contact}."

Elaine: Will add {customer_messaging_owner} and {account_team_contact}. Also adding a decision tree: "Is customer-visible impact present? -> Yes: status page + customer email (per threshold). No: internal comms only." Will also add a 1-page cheat sheet pinned to #incidents.

Kim: Approving structure; will leave inline PR tweaks.

Raj: +1. Also recommend a short P1 vs P2 usage table in the PR so folks know which templates to use.

incident-bot: PR merged by Elaine 12 commit: 9f1c3a7. Release: incident-comm-templates v1.0.

Elaine: Thanks all. I'll add a short link to the on-call rota and pin the cheat sheet to #incidents after lunch. Please react on PR if you want additional canned lines.

Kim: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
